decision_rule: Controlled synthetic diagnostic, not a floor or C5 serving claim: 24 alternating matched off/on pairs, each arm running a single pinned synthetic process for 16 CPU-seconds while the on arm records the actual compact observer across 96 CPUs and five tracepoint sources each. The 16-second CPU-time choice is an approximate sizing proxy informed by a retained C2 17.06-second request measurement window, not a representation of C5 workload. For every arm retain work count and CPU/wall durations; for every on unit independently verify owner markers, 480-source census, per-source terminal positions/counters and compact raw archive plus cleanup. Stop on first malformed receipt, loss, limit, STOP or deadline; incomplete is inconclusive. Full completion supports a descriptive synthetic observer-off/on comparison only, not execution placement, contention, losslessness, serving overhead, DS41 floor or promotion. No interim performance or gate decision.
duration_basis: 48 arms each consume 16 CPU-seconds, establishing at least 768 seconds before 24 full 480-source attach/teardown, independent archive replay, process scheduling and result custody. An 1800-second planning estimate allows roughly 43 seconds of overhead per observed pair; this overhead is unmeasured and the estimate is uncertain, not a claim it will finish. The 3600-second hard cutoff bounds uncertainty. Smoke uses one 0.1 CPU-second pair over 4 CPUs only and is functional transport, not a timing sample.
